rca of the issue: Original RCA (iter-21): The four PUT/finalize handlers for SRN and ERN updated SRN.racking_status / ERN.racking_status via _recompute_*_racking_status helpers but never recomputed the parent RN status. Since RN.FULLY_RACKED depends on (RN.received fully racked) AND (all descendant SRNs fulfilled) AND (all descendant ERNs accepted/decided), edits or finalizations of SRN/ERN that should flip the parent RN's status left it stale. Fix: appended `await _recompute_rn_status(parent_rn_id)` after each _recompute_*_racking_status call in all four handlers. Verified now via dedicated regression test + full suite.
